rule: pool = Chhunneng chat words, then the agent's extra chat list, then the Chhunneng 1000-common list in file order; first 320 unique single Khmer tokens; split by sha256(seed:word), lowest half = test
test_policy: test words never enter any training file (Chhunneng, Gemini drafts or typing rows are filtered by Khmer word); their typed answers stay local
